studio.name: Aariv's web studio
studio.method: I direct AI coding agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Antigravity) that do the typing; I plan, spec, review and test every change before it ships.

sites.name: The Sunshine Fund
sites.what: Houston foster-based cat rescue: mission, adoptable cats, donate pathways. Built to load fast and read warmly on a phone, since most donors arrive from social links.

sites.name: East Spring Branch Food Pantry
sites.what: Free-food pantry in Houston, TX: hours, location, what to expect on a first visit. Plain language and large type, because visitors are often in a hurry or stressed.

sites.name: Dori's Darlings
sites.what: No-kill cat rescue in Houston, TX: adoptable cats, foster program and donate flow. Designed around big friendly photography and a sticky donate path, since rescue sites live or die on donations.

sites.name: Good Mews for Ferals
sites.what: Houston community-cat rescue (trap, neuter, return): explains TNR in plain language with a step-by-step for first-time colony caretakers. Information-first design; the audience needs answers, not animations.

tools.name: Regatta
tools.what: macOS app for running several AI coding agents at once, with repo-safety rails

tools.name: wasitme
tools.what: 'Was it me, or the model?' - timeline of what changed in your Claude Code / Codex sessions

tools.name: armillary
tools.what: Mac app that archives every AI coding agent's session history privately

tools.name: busyholm
tools.what: A papercraft river island on the screen edge that grows from real agent activity
